name: @kitora/form-builder
description: Kitora's visual form builder: a field palette, a drag-to-reorder canvas of live widgets, a properties panel (label, name, required, rules, options, conditions, default), sections and wizard steps, preview, undo and redo, and export / import as the form engine's JSON definition rendered by AutoForm.

exports.name: isContainer
exports.description: Whether `item` holds children (a section or a step).

exports.name: BuilderField
exports.description: A field: the engine's node as is.

exports.name: BuilderSection
exports.description: A titled block of fields with a column count.

exports.name: BuilderStep
exports.description: A wizard step; holds fields and sections.

exports.name: BuilderRaw
exports.description: Any other engine node, kept verbatim (shown locked on the canvas, exported unchanged).

exports.name: BuilderItem
exports.description: One item of a builder document: a field, a section, a step or a raw engine node.

exports.name: BuilderItemKind
exports.description: The kind of a builder item: `field`, `section`, `step` or `raw`.

exports.name: BuilderContainer
exports.description: Items that hold children.

exports.name: DefExtras
exports.description: Every definition member other than `version` and `fields` (derived, validate, effects …), carried through untouched.

exports.name: BuilderDoc
exports.description: The whole document. `items` is the top level; `extras` round-trips what the builder does not edit.

exports.name: ROOT_ID
exports.description: The id the top level answers to as a drop container.

exports.name: EMPTY_DOC
exports.description: An empty document.

exports.name: IdFactory
exports.description: Makes a fresh builder id. Injected so tests can be deterministic; the default is random.

exports.name: randomId
exports.description: Random short ids (`f_x1y2z3`); collision-safe enough for one document.

exports.name: findItem
exports.description: Where the item with `id` lives in `doc` (searched depth first), or null when there is none.

exports.name: childrenOf
exports.description: The children of a container id (`ROOT_ID` = the top level); null when the id is no container.
exports.signature: (doc: BuilderDoc, containerId: string) => readonly BuilderItem[] | null

exports.name: containerKind
exports.description: The kind of a container id: `"root"`, `"section"`, `"step"`, or null for no container.

exports.name: isWizard
exports.description: True when the top level is a wizard (holds at least one step).

exports.name: canPlace
exports.description:
May an item of `kind` be placed in `containerId`? `movingId` is the item being
moved (so a wizard's only step can still be reordered, and a container is never
dropped into itself or its own subtree).
exports.signature: (doc: BuilderDoc, kind: BuilderItemKind, containerId: string, movingId?: string) => boolean

exports.name: insertItem
exports.description: Insert `item` at `index` of `containerId`; the same doc when placement is refused.
exports.signature: (doc: BuilderDoc, item: BuilderItem, containerId: string, index: number) => BuilderDoc

exports.name: removeItem
exports.description: Remove the item `id` (and its subtree).

exports.name: moveItem
exports.description:
Move `id` to `index` of `containerId`, where `index` counts the target list
BEFORE the item leaves it (the drop position the user saw). The same doc when
placement is refused or nothing changes.
exports.signature: (doc: BuilderDoc, id: string, containerId: string, index: number) => BuilderDoc

exports.name: updateItem
exports.description: Replace the item `id` with `fn(item)`; `fn` must keep the id and kind.
exports.signature: (doc: BuilderDoc, id: string, fn: (item: BuilderItem) => BuilderItem) => BuilderDoc

exports.name: updateField
exports.description: Update a field's engine node. A no-op for other kinds.
exports.signature: (doc: BuilderDoc, id: string, fn: (node: FieldNode) => FieldNode) => BuilderDoc

exports.name: fieldNames
exports.description: Every field name in the document (fields only; raw nodes are opaque), in document order.

exports.name: allFields
exports.description: Every field item, in document order.

exports.name: uniqueName
exports.description: `base` if free, else `base2`, `base3` … (names must be unique: they are the payload keys).

exports.name: toIdentifier
exports.description: "First name" → "firstName": a label as a camelCase payload key.

exports.name: duplicateItem
exports.description: Duplicate `id` right after itself, with fresh ids and fresh unique names. Returns the doc and the copy's id.
exports.signature: (doc: BuilderDoc, id: string, newId: IdFactory) => { doc: BuilderDoc; copyId: string | null; }

exports.name: uniqueStepId
exports.description: A step id not used by another step.

exports.name: wrapInStep
exports.description:
Turn a flat form into a wizard: the current top-level items move into one new
step (a step cannot sit beside loose fields). Already a wizard: the same doc.

exports.name: renameField
exports.description:
Rename a field and follow the rename everywhere the builder can read it:
every simple condition (`visibleIf`, a conditional `required`) on any item
that read the old name now reads the new one. Custom expressions are left
alone (the builder never rewrites what it cannot parse).
exports.signature: (doc: BuilderDoc, id: string, name: string) => BuilderDoc

exports.name: ItemLocation
exports.description: Where an item lives: its container id (`ROOT_ID` for the top level) and index there.

exports.name: isLayoutType
exports.description: Whether `type` is a layout entry (`$section` or `$step`) rather than an engine widget type.

exports.name: entryFor
exports.description: The palette entry for a type, or a generic one for a type the palette does not list (an imported third-party widget).

exports.name: newFieldNode
exports.description: A fresh field node for a palette entry, named `name`.

exports.name: PALETTE_GROUPS
exports.description: Palette groups, in display order.

exports.name: PaletteGroup
exports.description: A palette group name, one of `PALETTE_GROUPS`.

exports.name: LAYOUT_TYPES
exports.description: Layout entries are not engine widget types; they make a section or a step.

exports.name: LayoutType
exports.description: A layout palette type: `$section` or `$step`.

exports.name: PaletteEntry
exports.description: One draggable palette entry: the type it makes, its label and group, and the node a fresh drop starts as.

exports.name: DEFAULT_PALETTE
exports.description: The default palette: the engine widgets a JSON definition can carry with no code.

exports.name: OPTION_TYPES
exports.description: Types whose value is picked from `options` (the panel shows the options editor).

exports.name: MULTI_OPTION_TYPES
exports.description: Types that take several option values (an array default).

exports.name: TEXT_TYPES
exports.description: Types whose value is text (length and pattern rules apply).

exports.name: NUMBER_TYPES
exports.description: Types whose value is a number (min / max / integer rules apply).

exports.name: BOOLEAN_TYPES
exports.description: Types whose value is a boolean.

exports.name: PLACEHOLDER_TYPES
exports.description: Types with a placeholder.

exports.name: toExpr
exports.description: The JSON Logic expression for a simple condition.

exports.name: parseCondition
exports.description: Read an expression back as a simple condition; null when it is anything richer.

exports.name: describeCondition
exports.description: One-line reading of a condition for the canvas ("when plan is pro").

exports.name: coerceConditionValue
exports.description: Coerce the text a user typed into the value a condition on a field of `type` should compare.

exports.name: CONDITION_OPS
exports.description: Operators the panel offers; the label is what the menu shows.

exports.name: ConditionOp
exports.description: A condition operator the panel offers, a key of `CONDITION_OPS`.

exports.name: VALUE_OPS
exports.description: Operators that compare against a value (the others take none).

exports.name: SimpleCondition
exports.description: A condition the panel can edit as "field · operator · value".

exports.name: toFormDef
exports.description: The engine definition for a document.

exports.name: fromFormDef
exports.description: Wrap a definition's nodes for the canvas; members other than `fields` go to `extras`.

exports.name: exportJSON
exports.description: Serialize a document as the engine's JSON definition, pretty-printed.

exports.name: importJSON
exports.description: Parse and validate JSON text as an engine definition, then wrap it. Never throws.
exports.signature: (text: string, opts: ImportOptions, newId: IdFactory) => ImportResult

exports.name: ExportResult
exports.description: What `exportJSON` returns: the definition JSON and the escape hatches the engine reported.

exports.name: ImportOptions
exports.description: What the import check needs: the registry the runtime will use and the widget types the renderer knows.

exports.name: ImportResult
exports.description: The result of `importJSON`: the wrapped document, or the reason the text was rejected.

exports.name: createHistory
exports.description: A history with `present` and no steps to undo or redo.

exports.name: commit
exports.description: Record `next` as the new present. The same value (no change) is ignored.
exports.signature: <T>(h: History<T>, next: T, mergeKey?: string) => History<T>

exports.name: undo
exports.description: Step back one snapshot; the same history when there is nothing to undo.

exports.name: redo
exports.description: Step forward one undone snapshot; the same history when there is nothing to redo.

exports.name: reset
exports.description: Replace everything (an import, a template): undoable back to what was there.

exports.name: HISTORY_LIMIT
exports.description: Most undo steps kept; older ones drop off the bottom.

exports.name: History
exports.description: Undo / redo state over snapshots of `T`: the steps behind, the present, and the steps undone.

exports.name: isValidName
exports.description: Whether `name` is a plain path the engine can read: letters, digits and `_`, dot-separated, not starting with a digit.

exports.name: findProblems
exports.description: Every problem in `doc`: duplicate or invalid names, conditions on missing fields, choice fields with no options, empty steps and sections.

exports.name: Problem
exports.description: One thing wrong with the form, on one item.

exports.name: initialState
exports.description: The state for a fresh builder on `doc`: no history, nothing selected, edit mode.

exports.name: itemFromEntry
exports.description: The new item a palette entry makes, named / numbered uniquely in `doc`.
exports.signature: (doc: BuilderDoc, entry: PaletteEntry, newId: IdFactory) => BuilderItem

exports.name: builderReducer
exports.description: The builder's reducer: applies `action` to `state`, recording document changes in the history. Framework-free; React wraps it in `useReducer`.
exports.signature: (config: ReducerConfig, state: BuilderState, action: BuilderAction) => BuilderState

exports.name: BUILDER_MODES
exports.description: Edit the canvas, or try the form as a user would.

exports.name: BuilderMode
exports.description: Edit or preview, one of `BUILDER_MODES`.

exports.name: BuilderState
exports.description: The builder's whole state: the document history, the selection and the mode.

props.name: history
props.description: The document and its undo / redo steps; `history.present` is the current document.

props.name: selectedId
props.description: The id of the selected item, or null for none.

props.name: mode
props.description: Whether the canvas is being edited or the form previewed.

exports.name: BuilderAction
exports.description: Everything `builderReducer` can do to the state; every document change becomes one undo step.

exports.name: ReducerConfig
exports.description: What the reducer needs besides the state: the palette entries a drop resolves against and the id factory.

exports.name: entryKind
exports.description: The item kind a palette entry makes.

exports.name: sourceKind
exports.description: What kind of item a drag source (by dnd id) would place: a palette entry's, or the dragged item's own.
exports.signature: (doc: BuilderDoc, palette: readonly PaletteEntry[], sourceId: string) => BuilderItemKind | null

exports.name: acceptsDrop
exports.description: May the drag source `sourceId` drop into the builder container `containerId`?
exports.signature: (doc: BuilderDoc, palette: readonly PaletteEntry[], containerId: string, sourceId: string) => boolean

exports.name: dropIndex
exports.description: Where a drop lands in `containerId`: before / after the item `targetId`, or at the end. Null for an unknown container.
exports.signature: (doc: BuilderDoc, containerId: string, targetId: string | null, position: string) => number | null

exports.name: clickPlacement
exports.description:
Where a clicked (not dragged) palette entry lands: into the selected section /
step when one is selected, else right after the selected item when it may sit
there, else at the end of the form (or of the last step of a wizard). Null
when nowhere takes it.
exports.signature: (doc: BuilderDoc, palette: readonly PaletteEntry[], selectedId: string | null, entryType: string) => Placement | null

exports.name: PALETTE_CONTAINER
exports.description: The palette's dnd container; drops never land here.

exports.name: paletteDragId
exports.description: The dnd id of a palette entry's drag source.

exports.name: paletteTypeOf
exports.description: The palette type a dnd id names, else null.

exports.name: containerDndId
exports.description: The dnd id of a builder container (`ROOT_ID` or a section / step id).

exports.name: containerOf
exports.description: The builder container a dnd container id names, else null.

exports.name: Placement
exports.description: A place in the document: container plus index.

exports.name: jsonCodec
exports.description: The default codec: the form engine's JSON definition (`toJSON` out, the `fromJSON` check in).

exports.name: memoryStorage
exports.description: Storage in a variable: for tests, demos, and a page that saves to its own state.
exports.signature: (initial?: string | null) => BuilderStorage & { readonly peek: () => string | null; }

exports.name: EncodeResult
exports.description: What `encode` hands back: the text, plus anything the format could not carry.

exports.name: BuilderCodec
exports.description: Turns a document into text and back. `decode` never throws: it returns `{ ok: false, error }`.

exports.name: JsonCodecOptions
exports.description: Options for `jsonCodec`.

exports.name: JSON_CODEC
exports.description: The shared default instance.

exports.name: MaybePromise
exports.description: A value now, or later.

exports.name: BuilderStorage
exports.description: Where a host keeps the encoded document. Either method may be sync or async; a refusal throws.

exports.name: commandAction
exports.description: The action a command runs on `state`, or null when it does nothing there (no selection, preview mode).

exports.name: COMMAND_SCOPES
CommandScope
exports.description: Where a command's key may fire, one of `COMMAND_SCOPES`.

exports.name: BuilderCommandInfo
exports.description: One builder command as data: its title, default keys and scope.

exports.name: BUILDER_COMMAND_IDS
exports.description: The command ids, in the order a cheatsheet lists them.

exports.name: BuilderCommandId
exports.description: A builder command id, one of `BUILDER_COMMAND_IDS`.

exports.name: BUILDER_COMMANDS
exports.description: The default manifest. A host rebinds through its own `KeyboardProvider`, not by editing this.

exports.name: BUILDER_COMMAND_CATEGORY
exports.description: The category the commands show under in a host's shortcuts editor.

exports.name: CANVAS_SELECTOR
exports.description: The attribute value the canvas element carries (`data-fb="canvas"`); the `canvas` scope looks for it.

exports.name: copyText
exports.description: Copy `text` to the clipboard; resolves false when the browser refuses (no permission, insecure origin).

exports.name: downloadText
exports.description: Save `text` as a file download.
exports.signature: (text: string, fileName: string, mimeType?: string) => void

exports.name: localStorageAdapter
exports.description:
`BuilderStorage` over `window.localStorage` under `key`. A private window or
blocked site data can refuse storage: `load` then answers null and `save`
throws an Error whose message says so, for the host to show.

exports.name: FormBuilderProvider
exports.description: Puts a builder in context for the pieces below. Pass `builder` from `useFormBuilder`, or `options` to make one here.

props.name: doc
props.description: The document, controlled. Pair with `onChange`.

props.name: defaultDoc
props.description: The starting document (uncontrolled).

props.name: defaultDef
props.description: Or start from an engine definition; wins over `defaultDoc`.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called with the document after every change (and on undo / redo).

props.name: selectedId
props.description: The selected item id, controlled (null for none).

props.name: defaultSelectedId
props.description: The starting selection (uncontrolled); null for none.

props.name: onSelectedIdChange
props.description: Called when the selection changes, with the new item id (null for none).

props.name: mode
props.description: Edit or preview, controlled.

props.name: defaultMode
props.description: The starting mode (uncontrolled).

props.name: onModeChange
props.description: Called when the mode changes, with the new mode.

props.name: palette
props.description: What the palette offers.

props.name: widgets
props.description: Widgets the canvas and preview render with (the engine's `defaultWidgets` when omitted).

props.name: registry
props.description: The registry an import is checked against (the engine's catalog registry when omitted).

props.name: codec
props.description: How the document becomes text and back (JSON panel, storage).

props.name: newId
props.description: Builder id factory (tests pass a counter).

props.name: builder
props.description: A builder from `useFormBuilder`; when given, the options are ignored.

props.name: children
props.description: The builder's parts.

exports.name: useBuilder
exports.description: The builder in context; throws outside `FormBuilderProvider` / `FormBuilder`.

exports.name: useFormBuilder
exports.description: Run a builder: state, dispatch and everything derived from the current document.

exports.name: FormBuilderApi
exports.description: A running builder, from `useFormBuilder` or `useBuilder`: the state, `dispatch`, and everything derived from the current document.

exports.name: FormBuilderOptions
exports.description: Options for `useFormBuilder` (and props of `FormBuilderProvider` / `FormBuilder.Root`): the document, selection and mode, each controlled or uncontrolled, plus the palette, widgets, registry and codec.

exports.name: BuilderDndProvider
exports.description: Wrap the palette and the canvas (both, so a drag crosses from one to the other).

props.name: children
props.description: The palette and the canvas (and anything around them).

exports.name: useAccept
exports.description: A stable `accept` for the builder container `containerId`, reading the latest document at call time.

exports.name: PaletteGroupView
exports.description: One palette group with the entries the filter leaves in it.

exports.name: StorageStatus
exports.description: Where a save / load stands.

exports.name: useAddEntry
exports.description: Click-to-add: adds a palette entry where `clickPlacement` puts it (after or into the selection).

exports.name: useBuilderStatus
exports.description: The toolbar's numbers: field and problem counts, undo / redo availability.
exports.signature: () => { readonly fieldCount: number; readonly problemCount: number; readonly canUndo: boolean; readonly canRedo: boolean; }

exports.name: useBuilderStorage
exports.description:
Save and load the builder's document through a `BuilderStorage` adapter,
encoded with the builder's codec. Load goes through the codec's check and is
one undo step. Pass the builder from `useFormBuilder` (or `useBuilder()`
inside a provider).
exports.signature: (storage: BuilderStorage, builder: FormBuilderApi) => { readonly save: () => Promise<void>; readonly load: () => Promise<void>; readonly status: StorageStatus; }

exports.name: usePaletteSearch
exports.description: The palette's filter state: the query, its setter, and the groups that still have entries.
exports.signature: () => { readonly query: string; readonly setQuery: (q: string) => void; readonly groups: readonly PaletteGroupView[]; readonly empty: boolean; }

exports.name: SCOPE_CONTEXT_KEYS
exports.description: The context key each scope's rules require.

exports.name: useBuilderShortcuts
exports.description:
Registers the builder's commands on the keyboard engine (the host's, or a
local one) while mounted and routes each to the builder in context when focus
is inside `root`. Returns the engine.

exports.name: FormBuilder
exports.description: The ready-made builder, with every part as a static member for composing your own.
